name: rf_bus_mark

params.purpose: RF bus mark/opcode value (r0, carries through to sub-write)
Pointer to RF/vif info struct (r1, reads offset 0xd byte and offset 8 pointer)
Index into indexed register array (r2, used as r6 + r2*4)
Flag/value word (r4, shifted into r6 via lsl #22)
Base address for indexed MMIO access (r6)

docstring: Programs a marker/value onto the RF bus by writing the param register (0x40240160) and triggering command 0x10 via 0x4024014c, then polling/waiting and acknowledging via 0x40240018.
